knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A porous item with possible concealed contamination goes to specialist review before any treatment.
Each decision has its own authority and evidence. Separate entries stop one from hiding a gap in another.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes a decision memo for a fictional mattress with three separate entries. Pass: property, risk and disposal each have their own entry with a named owner.
For a fictional set of items, the learner lists the items that stay out of use until specialist review. Pass: every porous item is listed.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed decision memo for a fictional item
stopWorkCriteria: A porous item is proposed for on-site treatment.
